delivery order and in cases where option clause is exercised during the extended delivery period the additional time shall commence from the last date of extended delivery period. The additional delivery time shall be (Increased quantity ÷ Original quantity) × Original delivery period (in days), subject to minimum of 30 days. If the original delivery period is less than 30 days, the additional time equals the original delivery period. The Purchaser may extend this calculated delivery duration up to the original delivery period while exercising the option clause. Bidders must comply with these terms. 2. Buyer Added Bid Specific ATC Buyer Added text based ATC clauses TERM AND CONDITIONS 1. A pre-bid meeting shall be held on 03 October 2026 , from 10:00 AM to 2:00 PM only, at the Office of the Block Medical Officer, Verinag. 2. Bidders intending to participate must attend the meeting within the prescribed time and co mply with the attendance and documentation requirements specified in the tender notice. 3. No separate pre-bid meeting shall ordinarily be conducted on any other date. Any change or additional arrangement shall be made only through an official notice issued by the compete nt authority. 4. The department shall issue a Pre-Bid Meeting Attendance Certificate to eligible attendees aft er verification of identity and authorization. 5. Where mandatory pre-bid attendance is permitted by the applicable procurement rules and expressly notified in the tender, only bidders possessing a valid certific ate issued by this office shall be considered eligible for further evaluation. 6. Attendance by an authorized representative shall be accepted only upon submission of a val id authorization letter and identity proof, wherever permitted under the tender conditions. 7. All clarifications raised during the pre-bid meeting shall be recorded. Any clarification affecti ng the tender conditions shall be issued officially and made available to all prospective bidd ers through the prescribed channel. 2. Eligibility of Local Sellers 1. Participation shall be restricted to eligible local sellers only where such restriction is expr essly authorized under the applicable procurement policy and stated in the tende r notice. 2. Each bidder shall submit valid documentary proof of local establishment, registration, or oth er prescribed local eligibility criteria. 3. The department reserves the right to verify the authenticity of all submitted documents with the issuing authorities. 4. Any bidder found to have submitted false, misleading, or forged documents shall be dealt wi th in accordance with the applicable procurement rules. 5. Local eligibility shall be assessed uniformly against the criteria published in the tender docu ment. No bidder shall be disqualified solely on an unpublished or discretionary criterion. 3. Mandatory Documents Every bidder shall submit the documents applicable to the nature of the procurement, including: 1. Valid business/trade registration certificate. 2. PAN card and GST registration certificate, wherever applicable. 3. Proof of local eligibility, where applicable. 4. Valid authorization or dealership certificate from the manufacturer, wherever required. 5. Experience and satisfactory performance certificates, where prescribed in the tender. 6. Signed and stamped copy of the tender document and acceptance of its terms and conditio ns. 7. EMD/tender fee documents, wherever applicable and legally required. 8. Bank account details and other documents specifically required by the tender notice.

9. Pre-Bid Meeting Attendance Certificate, if mandatory under the published eligibility conditio ns. Incomplete submissions shall be dealt with in accordance with the applicable tender rules and the provisions relating to clarification or rectification of deficiencies. 4. Accuracy and Verification of Documents All information furnished by the bidder must be true, complete, and verifiable. The department may verify submitted documents with the relevant authorities. Material misrepresentation, forged documents, or concealment of material facts may result i n disqualification or other action permitted under applicable rules. No alteration, overwriting, or unauthorized modification shall be permitted in submitted doc uments. Any permitted correction must be properly authenticated by the bidder. 5. Financial Bid and Quoted Rates Rates shall be quoted in the prescribed format only. The bidder shall clearly indicate applicable taxes, duties, transportation, installation, handlin g, and other charges, as relevant to the procurement. The quoted rates shall remain valid for the period specified in the tender document. Conditional quotations or quotations containing undisclosed additional charges may be rejec ted in accordance with the published tender criteria. The financial bid shall be opened and evaluated in accordance with the prescribed procurem ent procedure. The lowest quoted rate shall not automatically confer a right to award of contract if the bidd er fails to meet the prescribed eligibility, technical, quality, or other evaluation requirements . 6. Quality and Technical Specifications All goods or services supplied must strictly conform to the specifications, standards, and req uirements stated in the tender. Where applicable, medical products and equipment must comply with relevant statutory approvals, licensing, quality standards, and safety requirements. The department may inspect goods, verify samples, or request technical documentation wh ere these requirements are specified in the tender. Substandard, damaged, counterfeit, expired, or non-conforming items shall not be accepted. Replacement of rejected goods shall be made within the period stipulated by the departmen t, without additional cost where required under the contract. 7. Delivery and Performance The successful bidder shall complete delivery or performance within the period specified in t he purchase order or agreement. All transportation, packing, loading, unloading, and delivery expenses shall be borne by the supplier unless otherwise specified. The supplier shall ensure that goods are delivered to the designated location in proper condi tion. Delay, failure to deliver, or failure to perform contractual obligations may attract liquidated d amages, penalties, or other remedies expressly provided in the tender and permitted by law . 8. Earnest Money Deposit and Security Deposit EMD and performance security shall be furnished only in the amount and manner specified i n the tender. Exemptions shall be granted wherever mandated by applicable rules. Forfeiture of EMD or invocation of performance security shall be limited to the circumstance

s stated in the tender and permitted by law. The successful bidder shall furnish the required performance security within the prescribed period, where applicable. 9. Prevention of Collusion and Unfair Practices Bidders shall submit independent and genuine offers. Any collusive bidding, price-fixing, fraudulent representation, bribery, coercion, or other pro hibited practice shall be dealt with under the applicable procurement rules. A bidder shall disclose any conflict of interest wherever required. No bidder shall attempt to improperly influence the tendering or evaluation process. Any action taken on account of misconduct shall be supported by the applicable rules and a ppropriate procedure. 10. Inspection, Acceptance, and Payment Payment shall be processed after satisfactory delivery or performance, verification of requir ed documents, and acceptance by the authorized officer. The supplier shall submit the prescribed invoice, delivery challan, tax documents, and other supporting records. The department may withhold payment for disputed, rejected, or undelivered items in accor dance with the contract. No payment shall be due for goods or services that have not been supplied or accepted, exc ept where the contract expressly provides otherwise. 11. Disqualification and Contractual Action A bidder may be disqualified, or contractual action may be initiated against the successful bidder, on grounds permitted under the applicable rules, including: Submission of forged or materially false documents. Failure to satisfy published eligibility criteria. Proven collusion or prohibited practices. Failure to furnish required contractual security within the stipulated period, where applicabl e. Refusal to honour a valid contract or persistent failure to meet contractual obligations. Any disqualification, cancellation, or other adverse action shall be reasoned, documented, and con sistent with the applicable procurement procedure. 12. Right to Cancel or Reject The competent authority reserves the right to cancel the tender, reject bids, or take other action o nly on lawful, recorded grounds and in accordance with applicable procurement rules. Such action shall not be exercised arbitrarily or for the purpose of favouring or excluding a particular bidder. 13. Acceptance of Terms and Conditions Submission of a bid shall constitute acceptance of the published tender conditions, subject to appli cable law. Any deviation must be disclosed in the prescribed manner and shall be evaluated in acc ordance with the tender requirements. 14. Final Authority and Dispute Resolution All matters relating to the tender shall be governed by the applicable procurement rules, governm ent orders, and the terms of the executed contract. Disputes shall be addressed through the proce dure and jurisdiction prescribed by the applicable rules and contract.
